description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named InstancesSettings, which displays information about instances managed by an InstancesStore. It includes UI components for listing instances, showing errors, statuses, and individual instance details with various helper methods for iconography, status, and formatting.

classes.name: InstancesSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a list of connected instances with status details and actions.

methods.name: exerciseForTesting
methods.description: A static method for generating test data and previewing the InstancesSettings UI.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main SwiftUI View body rendering the components.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Constructs the header section with title and refresh button.

methods.name: instanceRow
methods.description: Builds a view for an individual instance, showing its icon, host, IP, version, device info, and status indicators.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a label with optional icon and text.

methods.name: presenceIndicator
methods.description: Displays presence status indicator (active, idle, stale).

methods.name: presenceStatus
methods.description: Determines the presence status label and color based on last activity timestamp.

methods.name: leadingDeviceIcon
methods.description: Provides the icon for a device based on its type.

methods.name: leadingDeviceSymbol
methods.description: Decides the symbol to visually represent a device.

methods.name: shouldShowUpdateRow
methods.description: Determines whether to show update info for an instance.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Returns a system icon name if available, with a fallback.

methods.name: isSystemSymbolAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a given system symbol exists.

methods.name: platformIcon
methods.description: Returns icon name based on platform prefix.

methods.name: prettyPlatform
methods.description: Formats a platform string into a user-friendly name.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceShortText
methods.description: Converts the reason string into a short text label.

methods.name: updateSummaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string of the last update time and source.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceHelp
methods.description: Provides detailed help text about the update source reason.
